# Tide Pit Gills prototype notices

This isolated prototype contains exact source from Tide Pit for Ksoloti Gills
and a minimal Mutable Instruments Braids, Clouds, and stmlib dependency closure.
The exact bytes and revisions are recorded in `SOURCE_LOCK.json`.

The build generates one Tide Pit voice derivative outside the vendored tree.
It changes exactly two undefined signed left shifts to defined multiplication by
two. The authoritative and generated hashes, range proof, and exact-output
requirement are recorded in `SOURCE_LOCK.json`; the upstream copy remains exact.
